card.name: Explaining how a system does something
card.fires_on: Words in technical explanations where a sentence is about to say how a process is carried out, by what, or where it happens, such as "in which", "is stored", or "does the card punching for you". It appears in descriptions of machines, storage, fuel cells and statistics.

modes.label: Process described by agent
modes.description: A verb or its object in a sentence saying what a device does or where something is stored.
modes.example: a digital machine does the card<< punching>> for you (on its hard

modes.label: Definition clauses
modes.description: Linking words that open a definition of a system, such as "in which" or "the" after "in which a state".
modes.example: approach to linear regression in<< which>> the statistical analysis is undertaken

modes.label: Contrast of components
modes.description: Words in a comparison of how a battery or shared server holds or shares things.
modes.example: In a battery,<< all>> the chemical components are stored inside the battery

card.writes: It favors words meaning "is done by" or "relies on" and disfavors words meaning "is able to".
card.plain: It marks technical explanations of how something works or is carried out by a particular part or system.
